newsitem.title: USA: Philadelphia Suburban unit seeks rate hike.
newsitem.headline: Philadelphia Suburban unit seeks rate hike.

text.p: Philadelphia Suburban Corp's Philadelphia Suburban Water Co said Friday it had filed with the Pennsylvania Public Utility Commission for a 13.2 percent rate increase.
The $17 million increase would raise rates for a typical residential customer by about $3.44 per month, to an average of $26.46, the company said.

Philadelphia Suburban Water said it has spent $68 million on improvements since its last rate hike request two years ago. The company serves 900,000 residents in 93 municipalities in Delaware, Chester, Montgomery and Bucks counties.
